Naviamp v2.11.0

Naviamp 2.11.0 is out, with a larger Aurral discovery hub, an official signed Linux Flatpak channel, and improvements to playback, internet radio and Android TV.

- Browse your Navidrome library on desktop, Android and Android TV, with iOS available through TestFlight.
- Get more accurate internet-radio titles and artwork, and useful live-radio controls on TV.
- Keep TV controls visible, choose new Now Playing artwork layouts, and see clearer repeat states.
- Enjoy fixes for track transitions, paused positions, album playback settings, lyrics and Android startup, plus updated translations.
- With a separate compatible Aurral connection, explore recommendations, catalog search, artists, releases, previews and charts, and follow request progress after reconnecting.

GitHub downloads contain v2.11.0. Store and TestFlight channels update separately. The signed Flatpak currently contains v2.10.0; its v2.11.0 update is pending signing. Direct Linux downloads already contain v2.11.0.

Update other devices to v2.11.0 before syncing the new artwork and TV settings. Original album Play-button Gapless and TV queue-end Autoplay reports remain under investigation; Android TV and Naviamp Connect remain beta. Full changes and known limits are in the release notes.

Thanks

- Welcome first-time contributor @crsthn-slv for radio, TV, playback and lyrics improvements, testing, and the Brazilian Portuguese translation.
- Welcome first-time contributor @sewnie for reporting the Android startup failure when the Cast module is unavailable.

Download and release notes: https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/releases/tag/v2.11.0
Installation and beta links: https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp#readme

Naviamp is an independent third-party client, unaffiliated with the Navidrome project.
